set -euo pipefail
docker run -d --name tc-smoke -p ${{ matrix.port }}:${{ matrix.port }} ${{ matrix.tag }}
cleanup() { docker logs tc-smoke || true; docker rm -f tc-smoke || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
for _ in $(seq 1 45); do
  if [ "${{ matrix.smoke }}" = "health" ]; then
    if curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:${{ matrix.port }}/health"; then
      echo "gateway /health ok"
      exit 0
    fi
  else
    # Bind smoke: any HTTP response (or even a reset after accept)
    # means the UI process bound 7860. Do not use curl -f — Gradio
    # may 4xx before the app is fully ready.
    if curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 -o /dev/null \
         "http://127.0.0.1:${{ matrix.port }}/"; then
      echo "ui port ${{ matrix.port }} bound"
      exit 0
    fi
  fi
  sleep 2
done
echo "::error::docker smoke (${{ matrix.target }}) did not become ready on port ${{ matrix.port }}"
exit 1
npm ci
npm run build

set -euo pipefail
REF="${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.event.release.tag_name || github.ref_name }}"
V="${REF#v}"
echo "version=${V}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "major_minor=$(echo "$V" | cut -d. -f1-2)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "resolved=${V} (event=${{ github.event_name }} ref=${REF} stage=${{ matrix.stage }})"

set -euo pipefail
# Resolve the tag across all trigger types. Under workflow_run
# github.event.release.tag_name is null and github.ref is main —
# workflow_run.head_branch carries the tag ref (e.g. v2.4.0).
TAG="${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.event.release.tag_name || github.ref_name }}"
echo "tag=${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "version=${TAG#v}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

set -euo pipefail
VERSION="${{ steps.ver.outputs.version }}"
# PyPI propagation is fast but not instant; retry briefly. If no
# iteration succeeds the loop falls through and the subsequent
# `tool-compass --version` invocation fails with a clear "command
# not found", which is the desired loud failure mode (CT-B-014).
install_ok=0
for _ in $(seq 1 12); do
  if pip install "tool-compass==${VERSION}"; then
    install_ok=1
    break
  fi
  sleep 10
done
if [ "$install_ok" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "::error::PyPI smoke failed: tool-compass==${VERSION} did not become installable in the propagation window"
  exit 1
fi
OUT="$(tool-compass --version 2>&1 || true)"
echo "tool-compass --version → $OUT"
echo "$OUT" | grep -Fq "${VERSION}" || {
  echo "::error::PyPI smoke failed: --version output did not contain ${VERSION}"
  exit 1
}

commands.step: Docker smoke — pull gateway + UI, --version matches tag
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}"
VERSION="${{ steps.ver.outputs.version }}"
GATEWAY="${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${VERSION}"
UI="${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:ui-${VERSION}"
docker pull "$GATEWAY"
docker pull "$UI"
OUT="$(docker run --rm --entrypoint tool-compass "$GATEWAY" --version 2>&1 || true)"
echo "docker gateway --version → $OUT"
echo "$OUT" | grep -Fq "${VERSION}" || {
  echo "::error::Docker gateway smoke failed: --version output did not contain ${VERSION}"
  exit 1
}
OUT_UI="$(docker run --rm --entrypoint tool-compass "$UI" --version 2>&1 || true)"
echo "docker ui --version → $OUT_UI"
echo "$OUT_UI" | grep -Fq "${VERSION}" || {
  echo "::error::Docker UI smoke failed: --version output did not contain ${VERSION}"
  exit 1
}

python -m pip install --upgrade pip
# [ui] pulls Gradio. A core-only `pip install .` freezes a binary
# that cannot serve `tool-compass ui` (the npx zero-prerequisite path).
pip install ".[ui]" "pyinstaller>=6.9.0"
python -c "import ui, gradio"

TAG="${{ inputs.tag || github.event.release.tag_name }}"
VERSION="${TAG#v}"
echo "version=${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "tag=${TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
# --collect-submodules covers dynamic imports MCP / Gradio / Rich pull in.
# --hidden-import ui: cli._cmd_ui imports ui inside try/except ImportError,
# which PyInstaller treats as optional and would drop from the freeze.
# --console keeps stdout/stderr behavior identical to `python cli.py`.
pyinstaller --onefile \
  --name "${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}" \
  --console \
  --collect-submodules mcp.client \
  --collect-submodules mcp.server \
  --collect-submodules mcp.types \
  --collect-submodules mcp.shared \
  --exclude-module mcp.cli \
  --exclude-module typer \
  --collect-submodules hnswlib \
  --collect-submodules numpy \
  --collect-submodules httpx \
  --hidden-import ui \
  --collect-submodules gradio \
  "${{ env.ENTRYPOINT }}"
OUTNAME="${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}-${VERSION}-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
mv "dist/${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}${{ matrix.ext }}" "dist/${OUTNAME}"
echo "Built: dist/${OUTNAME}"
ls -la "dist/${OUTNAME}"

VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
BIN="dist/${{ env.TOOL_NAME }}-${VERSION}-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
# --version is wired on the root parser as of v2.2.1 (a942a67).
"$BIN" --version
"$BIN" --help
# Zero-prerequisite `npx … ui` path. argparse prints this without
# importing ui.py; the freeze still needs [ui] + --hidden-import ui
# + --collect-submodules gradio or the launched binary cannot serve.
"$BIN" ui --help

TAG="${{ inputs.tag || github.event.release.tag_name }}"
VERSION="${TAG#v}"
cd artifacts
sha256sum * > "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"
echo "--- checksums-${VERSION}.txt ---"
cat "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"

PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./npm/package.json').version")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "Tag: ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} → ${TAG_VERSION}"
echo "npm/package.json: ${PKG_VERSION}"
if [ "${PKG_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match npm/package.json version ${PKG_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

PY_VERSION=$(python3 -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.loads(open('pyproject.toml').read())['project']['version'])")
TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
echo "pyproject.toml: ${PY_VERSION}"
if [ "${PY_VERSION}" != "${TAG_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${TAG_VERSION} does not match pyproject.toml version ${PY_VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

if ! grep -Fq "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" npm/bin/tool-compass.js; then
  echo "::error::npm/bin/tool-compass.js does not reference ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} — run scripts/sync-version.mjs before tagging"
  exit 1
fi
echo "npm/bin/tool-compass.js references ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} ✓"
npm install --no-audit --no-fund
npm pack --dry-run

# Extract the [<version>] section from CHANGELOG.md as the release
# notes. Falls back to the tag name if the section is missing/empty.
VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
NOTES_FILE="$(mktemp)"
awk -v ver="${VERSION}" '
  $0 ~ "^## \\[" ver "\\]" {capture=1; next}
  capture && /^## \[/ {exit}
  capture {print}
' CHANGELOG.md > "${NOTES_FILE}"

if [ ! -s "${NOTES_FILE}" ]; then
  echo "Tool Compass ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" > "${NOTES_FILE}"
  echo "" >> "${NOTES_FILE}"
  echo "See CHANGELOG.md for details." >> "${NOTES_FILE}"
fi

# Create the release only if it doesn't already exist. Binaries attach
# next; npm publish waits until those assets exist. Skipping when it
# exists makes the step idempotent on workflow_dispatch re-runs /
# second tag pushes (no HTTP 422 "tag_name already exists").
if gh release view "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release ${GITHUB_REF_NAME} already exists; skipping create."
else
  gh release create "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
    --title "Tool Compass ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
    --notes-file "${NOTES_FILE}" \
    --verify-tag
fi

commands.step: Install npm 11.5.2 in sandbox for OIDC trusted-publishing auth
commands.text:
# Node 22 ships npm 10.9, which signs Sigstore provenance fine but
# cannot negotiate the OIDC auth path for trusted publishing — the
# PUT returns a misleading 404 "not in this registry". npm 11.5+ is
# required. Pin an exact 11.5.x — never @latest — so a compromised
# or unexpected latest tarball cannot inherit this job's OIDC identity.
# Bump via PR / manual review (sandbox is not a Dependabot ecosystem).
#
# An in-place `npm install -g npm@latest` races on Node 22's bundled
# npm 10.9 arborist rebuild and breaks irrecoverably (MODULE_NOT_FOUND:
# promise-retry). Sandbox install + PATH shadow avoids the race.
SANDBOX="$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX"
pushd "$SANDBOX" >/dev/null
echo '{"name":"npm-cli-sandbox","version":"0.0.0","private":true}' > package.json
npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund --silent npm@11.5.2
popd >/dev/null
echo "$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
INSTALLED="$("$SANDBOX/node_modules/.bin/npm" --version)"
echo "sandboxed npm ${INSTALLED}"
if [ "$INSTALLED" != "11.5.2" ]; then
  echo "::error::sandboxed npm is ${INSTALLED}, expected 11.5.2 (do not float @latest)"
  exit 1
fi

commands.step: Verify GitHub Release binaries and checksums exist
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
VERSION="${TAG#v}"
echo "Checking Release ${TAG} assets before npm publish..."
ASSETS="$(gh release view "${TAG}" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name')"
echo "${ASSETS}"
missing=0
for f in \
  "tool-compass-${VERSION}-linux-x64" \
  "tool-compass-${VERSION}-darwin-arm64" \
  "tool-compass-${VERSION}-win-x64.exe" \
  "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"
do
  if ! printf '%s\n' "${ASSETS}" | grep -Fxq "${f}"; then
    echo "::error::GitHub Release ${TAG} is missing asset ${f} — refusing npm publish"
    missing=1
  fi
done
if [ "${missing}" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::npx @mcptoolshop/tool-compass would be unable to fetch/verify a binary. Fix Release assets, then re-run."
  exit 1
fi
echo "All required Release assets present; npm publish may proceed."
npm install --no-audit --no-fund

commands.step: Publish to npm with provenance (OIDC trusted publisher)
commands.text: npm publish --provenance --access public
